ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Flourishing yellow flowers travels with the proposition that yellow flowers are wisdom, while the records preserve affirmation, rejection, and interview testing of that formula.
EvidenceBody: The headword occurs 64 times in 45 allowlisted files and works; the fuller yellow-flowers-and-wisdom formula occurs 24 times in 21 files and works. A question to National Teacher Huizhong reports disagreement over the proposition, and his answer accepts it by placing bamboo and flowers within the range of the teaching body and wisdom. A transmitted exchange then has Dazhu Huihai distinguish wisdom appearing in response to flowers from wisdom being located in the flowers. Shending Yikui rebukes people who hold rigidly to the formula, calling a fitting phrase a donkey-tethering stake, and elsewhere uses the flowers as a live examination question. The plant image therefore becomes a portable, disputed proposition rather than a single uncontested equation.
